title: Officials Discuss Bond Election; No Action
summary:
*   Austin officials met to discuss the appointment of election officials for an upcoming bond election.
*   After discussion, no further actions or appointments were made regarding the election officials.
*   The brief meeting, a continuation from the previous day, concluded without any decisions on its single agenda item.
